collision_guard: Stop at next100-step checkpoint as soon as serial current_job enters the last n3 condition or reaches n4/n5; original serial controller remains completion owner.
resume_rule: Serial trainer skips complete records or resumes latest model+optimizer+CPU/CUDA RNG for partial fits.
ownership: Only n4 schedule, checkpoints and fit records are written in main training directories. Worker status/current_job markers remain isolated here.
